source_review.notes: Checked Bryant–O'Hallaron against the CMU author and Pearson records, Levine against publisher front matter, ELF loading against the maintained gABI, exec inheritance/replacement against POSIX.1-2024 Issue 8, and linker behavior against current GNU Binutils documentation.

evidence: Checked module definition/reference sets, resolve relation, symbol/place/addend relocation variables, segment file/virtual intervals, sizes, alignment, and permissions.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Source names, symbols, sections, segments, file offsets, virtual addresses, runtime values, and process identities remain distinct.

evidence: Reproduced the executable definition table, empty unresolved set, R-X/RW grouping, and entry output; independently recomputed 0x1200-4-0x1004=0x1f8 and Exercise 3 results 0x5008 and 0x18.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Executable symbol grouping is explicitly a simplified model, not an ELF implementation.

evidence: Checked foundational symbol completeness against the union of definition sets and derived absolute S+A and PC-relative S+A-P expressions under their declared variables.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Weak symbols, versions, interposition, archive extraction, field encoding, and overflow remain target-policy refinements rather than hidden assumptions.

evidence: Checked duplicate and missing symbols, unresolved dynamic dependencies, sections versus segments, zero-filled memory, demand paging, startup-before-main failure, exec replacement, stripped diagnostics, cross-target artifacts, symbol-version drift, and name-resolved ABI mismatch.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Static linking is not described as removing kernel, CPU, operating-system, or configuration dependencies.

evidence: Checked symbol completeness, relocation formula/fit qualification, runtime permission separation, caller-callee ABI agreement, loader/startup/application ordering, and source-to-artifact provenance requirements.
invariant_checking.notes: Each failure example is assigned to its earliest evidenced stage.

evidence: Reviewed both relocation calculations line by line, including hexadecimal subtraction; reviewed the foundational resolution predicate and duplicate-definition counterexample against explicit strong-definition assumptions.
proof_review.notes: No arithmetic result is claimed encodable without ABI width, signedness, alignment, and relocation-kind checks.

evidence: Audited uses of rule, invariant, proof, model, ABI, standard, and conclusion; simplified models are labeled and platform-specific claims cite their authority.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Detailed compiler internals, numeric representation, assembly, dynamic linking, and OS implementation remain with later modules/programs.

evidence: Build, link, load, startup, and execution outcomes are separated; artifact inspection and production launch tests are bounded to exact targets, toolchains, dependencies, and host images.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: A passing build is never presented as deployment or ABI correctness proof.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter establishes the complete source-to-process causal pipeline, symbol and relocation foundations, sections versus segments, dynamic loading, runtime startup, ABI, and process-image replacement without absorbing the later specialized modules.

practitioner_review.notes: Separate compilation, missing libraries, symbol versions, stripped production symbols, artifact provenance, cross-distribution deployment, pre-main failures, and ABI drift capture realistic native build and operations failures.

pedagogical_review.notes: Ten examples progress from separate compilation through resolution, relocation, mappings, zero fill, dynamic dependencies, startup, exec, diagnostics, and ABI corruption; five exercises culminate in a production symbol-version diagnosis and release gate with complete answers.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
